description: Daily balancing formula for hair and scalp with vitamin conditioning.
raw_text: Ingredients: Water (Aqua), Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Glycerin, Sodium Chloride, Panthenol, Fragrance (Parfum), Phenoxyethanol, Citric Acid, Limonene, Linalool.
summary: A standard cleansing shampoo formulated with surfactant cleansing agents (SLES + CAPB), humectants (glycerin, panthenol), and preservative stabilizers. It contains fragrance compounds (limonene, linalool) which may be relevant for sensitive or reactive scalps.

ingredients.name: Water (Aqua)
ingredients.why_used: Acts as the base liquid vehicle to dissolve and disperse all cleansing and conditioning ingredients.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Purified water is the universal dermatological solvent.
ingredients.unknown_info: Specific mineral deionization rating is unstated.

ingredients.name: Sodium Laureth Sulfate
ingredients.why_used: Lathers quickly and binds to sebum, dirt, and styling residue so they can be washed away with water.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Extensively evaluated by CIR. Milder than SLS, but can cause mild dryness or barrier disruption in prolonged contact.
ingredients.unknown_info: Product-specific active percentage is not disclosed on the label.

ingredients.name: Cocamidopropyl Betaine
ingredients.why_used: Mitigates the harshness of sulfate surfactants while boosting rich foam and texture.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Generally gentle, but trace manufacturing amine impurities can cause allergic contact dermatitis in sensitized individuals.
ingredients.unknown_info: Impurity test levels for residual DMAPA are not disclosed on packaging.

ingredients.name: Glycerin
ingredients.why_used: Attracts atmospheric moisture to the hair cuticle and scalp to help counter cleansing dryness.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Proven natural moisturizer with exceptional dermatological safety margin.

ingredients.name: Sodium Chloride
ingredients.why_used: Thickens the liquid shampoo into a rich, easily pourable gel.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Common table salt; alters micelle ionic strength without chemical hazard in rinse-off products.

ingredients.name: Panthenol
ingredients.why_used: Penetrates the hair cortex to improve elasticity, moisture retention, and shine.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Provitamin B5; recognized by CIR as non-irritating and deeply restorative.

ingredients.name: Fragrance (Parfum)
ingredients.why_used: Gives the shampoo a pleasant sensory scent and masks base surfactant odors.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Proprietary mixture that can cause contact dermatitis or respiratory irritation in sensitive persons.
ingredients.unknown_info: The individual aroma compounds within this blend are undisclosed trade secrets.

ingredients.name: Phenoxyethanol
ingredients.why_used: Prevents bacterial and fungal growth in the aqueous bottle over months of shower use.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Evaluated safe by EU SCCS up to 1.0%; can occasionally trigger contact sensitization on broken skin.

ingredients.name: Citric Acid
ingredients.why_used: Lowers shampoo pH to slightly acidic (~5.5) to keep the hair cuticle closed and smooth.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Normal biological acid, safe in topical personal care formulations.

ingredients.name: Limonene
ingredients.why_used: Adds a fresh citrus note.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Auto-oxidizes upon air exposure into hydroperoxides which can trigger skin sensitization.
ingredients.unknown_info: Degree of oxidation and age of bottle.

ingredients.name: Linalool
ingredients.why_used: Imparts a light floral lavender note.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Recognized fragrance allergen in oxidized state; declared per regulatory labeling rules.

description: Stone-ground seasoned tortilla chips with tangy barbecue spice mix.
raw_text: Ingredients: Whole Corn, Vegetable Oil (Sunflower and/or Canola), Salt, Monosodium Glutamate, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Xanthan Gum, Tocopherol, Natural Spices.
summary: Savory grain snack containing natural lipids, flavor enhancers (MSG), and organic acid preservatives. Good nutritional energy profile with moderate sodium content.

ingredients.name: Whole Corn
ingredients.why_used: Provides dietary complex carbohydrates, fiber, and primary chip structure.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Staple whole cereal grain.

ingredients.name: Monosodium Glutamate
ingredients.why_used: Heightens savory taste and depth of seasoning blend.
ingredients.evidence_summary: FAO/WHO JECFA and FDA confirm safety in culinary amounts; metabolized as natural glutamate.
ingredients.unknown_info: Exact mg of MSG per 30g serving.

ingredients.name: Citric Acid
ingredients.why_used: Adds characteristic tangy citrus bite to seasoning.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Normal cellular metabolite; FDA GRAS.

ingredients.name: Sodium Benzoate
ingredients.why_used: Prevents microbial growth in spice slurry.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Safe within ADI; note that trace benzene can form if combined with high ascorbic acid under heat.

ingredients.name: Tocopherol
ingredients.why_used: Prevents frying oils from oxidizing and going rancid on shelf.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Natural Vitamin E; protects polyunsaturated fatty acids safely.

description: Concentrated laundry detergent packs with bio-enzymes and oxygen brighteners.
raw_text: Ingredients: Anionic and Non-ionic Surfactants, Sodium Carbonate, Sodium Citrate, Sodium Percarbonate, Protease Enzymes, Optical Brighteners, Fragrance.
summary: Heavy-duty domestic laundry formulation utilizing bio-enzymes to break down stains and sodium percarbonate for color-safe oxygen bleaching. Concentrated pods present an ingestion/eye hazard if mishandled.

ingredients.name: Anionic and Non-ionic Surfactants
ingredients.why_used: Lifts oily grease and dirt particulates from fabric fibers into wash water.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Detergent surfactants are regulated under EU biodegradability standards; concentrated form is an eye irritant.
ingredients.unknown_info: Specific alkyl chain lengths and ethoxylation degree.

ingredients.name: Sodium Carbonate
ingredients.why_used: Maintains wash bath pH around 10.5 for optimal stain saponification.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Inorganic salt; hazard is localized eye and skin irritation due to alkalinity.

ingredients.name: Sodium Percarbonate
ingredients.why_used: Releases hydrogen peroxide upon dissolving in hot/warm water to oxidize organic stains.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Environmentally benign decomposition products (soda ash, water, oxygen); strong ocular irritant.

ingredients.name: Protease Enzymes
ingredients.why_used: Enzymatically cleaves difficult protein-based stains (blood, grass, food) at low wash temperatures.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Non-bioaccumulative biological catalyst; encapsulated in liquid pods to eliminate respiratory powder inhalation.

ingredients.name: Optical Brighteners
ingredients.why_used: Deposits microscopic whitening fluorophores on cotton fibers.
ingredients.evidence_summary: HERA confirms safe for consumer skin, though environmental aquatic persistence warrants moderation.

description: Niacinamide and Provitamin B5 peptide serum for barrier reinforcement.
raw_text: Ingredients: Aqua, Glycerin, Niacinamide, Panthenol, Phenoxyethanol, Xanthan Gum, Citric Acid.
summary: Clean minimalist leave-on barrier hydration formula. Free from added fragrances, essential oils, and drying alcohols. Suitable for reactive and sensitized skin.

ingredients.name: Glycerin
ingredients.why_used: Binds moisture within the stratum corneum and prevents moisture loss.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Gold standard natural humectant with impeccable safety.

ingredients.name: Niacinamide
ingredients.why_used: Boosts ceramide synthesis, reduces hyperpigmentation, and reinforces lipid matrix.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Extensively documented active; clinically validated at 2-5% concentration.

ingredients.name: Panthenol
ingredients.why_used: Calms irritations and supports tissue regeneration.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Converts to Vitamin B5; deeply restorative.

ingredients.name: Phenoxyethanol
ingredients.why_used: Guards the water-rich serum against bacterial contamination during dropper dispensing.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Regulated up to 1.0% maximum in the EU; well-tolerated on intact skin.

description: Ready-to-use spray cleaner targeting soap scum, grime, and grease.
raw_text: Ingredients: Purified Water, Sodium Citrate, Alcohol Ethoxylate Surfactants, Sodium Carbonate, Fragrance, Limonene.
summary: Non-chlorinated multi-surface cleaner using citrate chelators and carbonate builders to break grease and soap residues. Contains citrus fragrance compounds that require good ventilation.

ingredients.name: Sodium Citrate
ingredients.why_used: Binds hard water calcium and magnesium so surfactants work without leaving mineral film.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Readily biodegradable organic salt; EPA Safer Choice chemical.

ingredients.name: Alcohol Ethoxylate Surfactants
ingredients.why_used: Emulsifies kitchen cooking oils and bath scum.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Rapidly biodegradable; causes temporary eye stinging upon direct spray contact.

ingredients.name: Sodium Carbonate
ingredients.why_used: Maintains alkaline cleaning power to cut grease.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Common washing soda; non-systemic hazard limited to topical pH irritation.

ingredients.name: Fragrance
ingredients.why_used: Leaves a fresh clean scent in living areas.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Complex aroma mixture; can trigger respiratory airway irritation in asthma patients.

ingredients.name: Limonene
ingredients.why_used: Provides natural citrus grease-cutting action.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Contact allergen in oxidized state.
